result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text elements are overlapping in the restaurant listing section.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing, the delivery time text '25-30' and the word 'Delivery' are overlapping/colliding, making the text difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the spacing or layout logic for the restaurant metadata row to ensure the delivery time and delivery label do not overlap. Consider using a flexbox layout with appropriate gaps.
